from typing import List
from collections import Counter
class Solution:
    def unequalTriplets(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        cnt = Counter(nums)
        res = 0
        left = 0
        for v in cnt.values():
            right = n - left - v
            res += left * v * right
            left += v
        return res
